adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch the record via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` (lines ~10 and ~15 in the new file). If no record exists, `host` will be `nil`. `update` then calls `save_host(host)`, which immediately does `host.host = ...` and will raise `NoMethodError` on nil. `destroy` calls `host.destroy` and will also raise on nil. The diff contains no nil-check or `find`/404 handling, so stale/unknown IDs can produce a 500 instead of a 404.
